I hope it’s okay to gently share something here…

I recently came across something called The Career Power Circle — and it honestly felt like the kind of space many of us quietly need.

It’s a supportive online workshop (not just a casual gathering) designed for anyone who’s job hunting, switching careers, feeling stuck at work, or simply rethinking what’s next.

It’s guided with tools and prompts to help you get clear, confident, and unstuck — but also kind and reflective.
Think: structured support without the pressure. Real conversations. And actual strategies you can use.

If that sounds like something you’ve been needing, I can send the details. Once there’s a small group ready, the session will be scheduled.

No pressure — just wanted to pass it along in case it lands with someone reading this.
